verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a custom URI scheme (reflect://reflect?command=<command_name>&...) for performing in-app actions, including a command that appends text to today's daily note. Its OAuth2 REST API also exposes POST /graphs/{graphId}/notes to create notes and PUT for daily notes, so scripts can drive note creation from outside. missing for 10: documented deep-link commands for opening or navigating to a specific note, a full catalog of deep-link commands beyond the daily-note append, any local endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
